item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 16/Feb/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to affect Guangdong tomorrow. It will be cloudier over the region. Under the influence of a humid maritime airstream, it will be foggy over the coastal areas early to midweek next week, and it will be warm during the day. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China in the latter part of next week. Temperatures will fall over the region.
